title: Combine Sorted Priority Queues
description: You are organizing two separate lanes of incoming emergency patients at a hospital, where each lane is already sorted by severity score in ascending order. Write a routine to merge the two patient lists into a single sorted priority queue. The new list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists, returning the head of the merged linked list.
constraints: The number of nodes in both lists is in the range [0, 50].
Both list1 and list2 are sorted in non-decreasing order.
input_format: Two heads of sorted singly linked lists, list1 and list2.
output_format: The head of the combined sorted singly linked list.

examples.explanation: The merged list contains all elements from both lists in sorted order.
Merging two empty lists results in an empty list.
Merging an empty list with a single element list returns that element.
